body.p: Response to Office Action of February 5, 2025 AMENDMENTS TO THE CLAIMS/CLAIM LISTPlease CANCEL claims 1-2 without prejudice or disclaimer.
Please AMEND claim 3 as shown below.
Please ADD claim 13 as shown below.
The following list of claims replaces any prior listing of claims:

br.br:
1-2. (Canceled)
3. (Currently Amended) A bracket comprising:
a bracket body having a hollow structure which is attached to a distal end surface a tool attachment surface of a hollow arm member serving as a tool attachment surface, the bracket body having a hollow hole that allows a wire body to pass therethrough from a hollow portion in the arm member into an interior of the bracket body through an opening on the tool attachment surface;
a bracket fixture that fixes the bracket body to the tool attachment surface from an inside of the bracket body;
an insulating member that is disposed between the bracket fixture and the bracket body, and that electrically insulates the bracket fixture from the bracket body; and
an[[the]] insulating cover that includes a plate-shaped flat portion according to Claim 1, being disposed in the interior of the bracket body and that covers both the bracket fixture and the hollow hole.
4. (Original) The bracket according to Claim 3, further comprising an annular clamp that is disposed in the hollow hole, and that fixes the wire body with respect to the tool attachment surface.
5. (Previously Presented) The bracket according to Claim 3, further comprising:
a presser plate that is disposed on the insulating cover on a side opposite to the tool attachment surface; and
a presser-plate fixture that fixes the presser plate to the bracket body.
6. (Previously Presented) The bracket according to Claim 3, further comprising a cover fixture that fixes the insulating cover to the bracket body.
7. (Previously Presented) The bracket according to Claim 3, wherein the insulating cover has a recessed portion into which a head portion of the bracket fixture is fitted, and is fixed to the bracket body by an engagement between the head portion and the recessed portion.
8. (Previously Presented) The bracket according to Claim 3, wherein the insulating cover is adhered to the bracket body.
9. (Original) The bracket according to Claim 5, wherein the presser plate has a wire-body fixing portion that fixes the wire body to the presser plate.
Attorney Docket No.: 05560245US Response to Office Action of February 5, 2025 10. (Previously Presented) A robot comprising:
a robot body that has at least one arm member and in which a distal arm member is hollow;
and the bracket according to Claim 3.
